fields.System.Title: CNT-203 — Count multiple batches in a location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a counter, I want to record a quantity for each batch present, so that a location
holding two batches does not produce a phantom variance on the one I did not see.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a location expected to hold several batches, then the task lists the batch
  • numbers expected — without quantities.
  • - Given the count, then a quantity must be entered for each listed batch, including zero.
  • - Given a batch found that was not expected, then it can be added to the count.
  • - Given a submitted count, then variance is calculated per batch, not per location total.
  • - Given an untracked product, then a single quantity is entered with no batch prompt.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory |
| Tables | count_result, batch |
| Risks | Only one batch counted, producing a phantom variance ([doc 09 §6.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
